test.create_query: CREATE TABLE cmp_uuid_ip ( u1 UUID, u2 UUID, ip4a IPv4, ip4b IPv4, ip6a IPv6, ip6b IPv6 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO cmp_uuid_ip SELECT reinterpretAsUUID(concat(reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, 1)), reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, 2)))), reinterpretAsUUID(concat(reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, if(number % 2 = 0, 1, 3))), reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, 4)))), toIPv4(cityHash64(number, 5)), toIPv4(cityHash64(number, if(number % 2 = 0, 5, 6))), CAST(reinterpretAsFixedString(reinterpretAsUUID(concat(reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, 7)), reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, 8))))) AS IPv6), CAST(reinterpretAsFixedString(reinterpretAsUUID(concat(reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, if(number % 2 = 0, 7, 9))), reinterpretAsFixedString(cityHash64(number, 10))))) AS IPv6) FROM numbers(10000000)
